summary: Tested new LinkedIn Lead CRM revamp (6 views + new stage endpoint). Backend: 6/6 pytest tests PASS covering /accounts, /cookie, /stats/overview, /connections (list), and the new PUT /connections/{public_id}/stage endpoint (both 404-on-missing and real update+persistence via GET verification). Frontend: All 6 views (Dashboard, Pipeline, Search, Contacts, Messages, Settings) render, sidebar navigation works via data-testid nav-{view}, Dashboard KPI cards + Recent Messages/Leads present, Pipeline shows Kanban with all 6 stages (New Lead 190 / Messaged 10 / others 0 out of 200 pipeline contacts), Search shows keyword 'looking for loyalty agency' + AI Comment buttons, Messages compose panel + history sidebar render, Settings shows LinkedIn Session cookie manager with 'Connected: Vineet Narang' status, TopHeader shows 'Vineet Narang' account switcher, LandingPage title 'LinkedIn Lead CRM' verified in AgentLogin header. Sidebar collapse toggle works. Found and fixed one integration bug: ContactsView was sending sort_dir as 'asc'/'desc' string but backend expects int (1/-1), causing 422 errors and 'No contacts found' despite 26,431 contacts existing. After fix, Contacts table shows 40 rows / 26431 total correctly.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED by testing agent: ContactsView sent sort_dir='asc'/'desc' but backend /api/li-search/connections expects int (1/-1). Was returning 422 and showing 'No contacts found' for all accounts.

action_items: None blocking. Consider aligning sort_dir semantics: either update backend to accept 'asc'/'desc' strings, or ensure all future views convert to 1/-1 (only ContactsView was affected).
critical_code_review_comments: CRMLayout is clean and modular (6 views ~200-400 lines each), replacing the 1162-line monolith — good refactor.
ContactsView.jsx uses direct axios calls with query params but did not coerce sort_dir type — a shared api helper or param validator would prevent 422s like this.
Old LinkedInSearch.jsx (1162 lines) is still in the codebase but unused per App.js — should be removed or archived to avoid confusion.
linkedin_search.py is now 2328 lines with 40+ routes — should be split into pipeline/messaging/search/accounts sub-routers.

PUT /connections/{public_id}/stage does not validate the 'stage' value against the allowed 6-stage enum (new_lead/connected/messaged/replied/follow_up/converted) — a client can persist arbitrary stage strings.
Frontend inline styles for the design tokens (#09090b/#18181b/#27272a/#2563eb) are duplicated across 8 files — extract to a theme constants file or tailwind config.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing account (Vineet Narang, 26,431 connections).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New CRM lives at /app/frontend/src/components/crm/. All 8 sub-components have data-testid on interactive elements (nav-{view}, crm-sidebar, sidebar-toggle, contacts-search, bulk-message-btn, etc). New backend endpoint PUT /api/li-search/connections/{public_id}/stage works. sort_dir bug in Contacts was fixed. Old LinkedInSearch.jsx still exists but unused. AGENT_PASSWORD is Agent@2024!.
rca of the issue: ContactsView passed sort_dir='asc' (string) to GET /api/li-search/connections which declares sort_dir: int = 1 in FastAPI. Pydantic v2 int_parsing raised 422, response body was JSON error, axios threw AxiosError, catch block only console.error'd, so UI silently showed empty list. Fix: coerce to 1/-1 in the params object. Verified post-fix: table populated with 26,431 total contacts, 40 rows/page rendering.
